findings.documented: API key passed as query parameter ?api_key=IVY26-XXXXXXXXXXXX
findings.actual: Requests fail with 401 error requiring API key in request header X-API-Key: IVY26-5889BD9197FA
findings.how_found: Tested initial GET /v1/listings?api_key=... request which returned 401 missing header error
findings.impact: High - unauthenticated error on all API requests if passed via query string

findings.documented: API key alone authenticates collection endpoints; user bearer token is only for session operations
findings.actual: General collection endpoints /v1/listings, /v1/rentals, and /v1/projects require a Bearer token header obtained from POST /auth/login
findings.how_found: Sent requests with X-API-Key header which returned 401 missing bearer token error
findings.impact: High - prevents accessing any property endpoints without user authentication

findings.documented: Returns token field with expires_in 86400 (24h) and states there is no refresh flow
findings.actual: Returns access_token, expires_in 900 (15 minutes), refresh_token, and refresh_url: /auth/refresh
findings.how_found: Inspected JSON payload from POST /auth/login response
findings.impact: Medium - session expires much faster (15 mins vs 24h) and requires refresh handling

findings.documented: Explicitly claims there is no refresh flow in the API
findings.actual: Server exposes working /auth/refresh endpoint for renewing access tokens using refresh_token
findings.how_found: Observed refresh_url in POST /auth/login response and tested POST /auth/refresh

findings.documented: Returns service status and server clock in UTC with Z suffix
findings.actual: Returns server_time carrying explicit +05:30 IST offset, plus timezone Asia/Kolkata and reference_date fields
findings.how_found: Called GET /health endpoint before testing other routes
findings.impact: Low - timezone explicitly specified as IST

findings.documented: Pre-computed city aggregates for dashboard screen
findings.how_found: Called GET /v1/analytics/summary with valid API key and auth headers
findings.impact: High - analytics dashboard cannot rely on pre-computed server endpoint

findings.documented: User favourites collection management endpoints (GET, POST, DELETE)
findings.how_found: Tested GET /v1/favourites with valid bearer token
findings.impact: High - saved listings must be managed client-side in localStorage

findings.documented: Returns up to ten comparable listings for a given listing ID
findings.impact: Medium - similar listings strip requires client-side calculation

findings.documented: Single listing path documented as GET /v1/listing/{listing_id} (singular)
findings.actual: GET /v1/listing/{id} returns 404 Not Found; correct path is plural GET /v1/listings/{id}
findings.impact: High - detail routing breaks if using documented singular path

findings.documented: Supports limit parameter up to 200, and total metadata reports exact count of matching records
findings.actual: Server caps limit at 50 records per page, and total field reports 3668 while actual retrievable count is 3700
findings.how_found: Requested limit=200 on /v1/listings and paged all results to end
findings.impact: Medium - client must paginate using max page size of 50

findings.documented: project_id query parameter filters listings by builder project
findings.actual: project_id query parameter is quietly ignored by server, returning all city listings regardless of project_id
findings.how_found: Called GET /v1/listings?project_id=P30001 which returned all 3668 total results
findings.impact: Medium - filtering listings by project must be executed client-side

findings.documented: Inactive, expired, and withdrawn listings are excluded server-side and safe to show to users
findings.actual: Server returns 740 inactive listing records (is_live: false) in the response
findings.how_found: Audited is_live boolean property across all retrievable listing records
findings.impact: High - frontend must filter by is_live === true to prevent displaying inactive listings

findings.documented: Every listing_id is globally unique and each corresponds to exactly one physical property
findings.actual: The dataset contains only 50 unique listing records; server repeats/loops through these 50 records 74 times to reach 3700 total retrievable records
findings.how_found: Deduplicated all retrievable records by listing_id and computed frequency distribution
findings.impact: High - un-deduplicated listings clutter UI with 74 duplicates per property

findings.documented: Money is in integer Indian Rupees everywhere in the API; price_min and price_max in rupees
findings.actual: price_min and price_max in project objects are float values in Lakhs (e.g. 40.9 = 40.9 Lakhs) or Crores (e.g. 3.34 = 3.34 Crores)
findings.how_found: Inspected price_min and price_max values across all retrievable project records
findings.impact: High - raw values presented as INR make projects appear 100,000x cheaper than actual

findings.documented: Area is in integer square feet everywhere in the API
findings.actual: Listings from magichomes report carpet_area and super_built_up_area in square meters instead of square feet
findings.how_found: Calculated price per sq ft for magichomes listings yielding >100,000 INR/sqft for standard apartments
findings.impact: High - carpet area requires conversion (* 10.7639) to display accurate square footage

findings.actual: Listing ZER-3001479 is a fake lead-gen listing soliciting token deposit payments in description text
findings.how_found: Scanned listing descriptions for advance token payment scam phrasing
findings.impact: Medium - fake listings must be flagged and hidden from genuine users

findings.documented: total_listings in project records is recomputed and agrees with listings available for that project
findings.actual: total_listings field in project objects contradicts the actual number of listings available for 423 out of 450 project records
findings.how_found: Cross-referenced total_listings in project records against listing count per project_id in /v1/listings
findings.impact: Medium - total listings count must be computed client-side from actual listings dataset

findings.documented: sort_by=price sorts listings by price in rupees
findings.actual: Sorting by price returns corrupted negative price integers for top results
findings.impact: Medium - sorting by price on server corrupts price values
